name: Continuum Explorer
tagline: A file manager built for using your phone like a desktop
description:
Continuum Explorer is a file manager designed for Android devices used in desktop mode, like Samsung DeX, or with a mouse and keyboard attached, such as tablets. It gives you a fuller, desktop-style way to browse and manage your files instead of a cut-down phone layout.

If you regularly use your Android device as a mini desktop, this is built with that setup in mind.
